Conversely, significant positive breakthroughs such as a major technological innovation, an unexpectedly strong economic boom, or a substantial, unanticipated positive policy announcement could propel the value far above the upper end of our forecast ranges. These types of "black swan" events are inherently difficult to predict but represent the primary risks to outcomes staying within the stated intervals.
